scenes.text: A digit has a different value in each place: hundreds, thousands, ten thousands, hundred thousands and millions. Multiply the digit by its place value.
In 174,769, what value does the digit in the 100,000 place column represent? The answer is 100,000. 1 times 100,000 equals 100,000.
A pupil at a market stall removes the contribution of the 1,000s digit from 938,988. What number remains? Pause the video and think.
A pupil at a market stall removes the contribution of the 1,000s digit from 938,988. What number remains? The answer is 930,988. Without the 1,000s contribution, 938,988 minus 8,000 equals 930,988.
